aboutTagline: Your windows, at hand like a deck of cards.

@appName.description: The product's name, large, in the first launch's animation.

@badgeDesktop.description: A window's Space, in the preview's header.

@badgeDisplay.description: A window on an external display.

@badgeFullScreen.description: A window in full screen or Split View.

@badgeHidden.description: A window of a hidden app (Cmd-H).

@guideActions.description: The guide: W, M and Q.

@guideClose.description: The guide: Escape or the shortcut again.

guideDetail: Windeck waits in the menu bar. Try these now:
guideNote: Change the shortcut in Settings → Shortcuts.
guideOpen: Open, then Tab down the list

@guideOpen.description: The guide: what the shortcut does.

guideQuick: A quick press goes back to the last window

@guideQuick.description: The guide: a quick press of the shortcut.

guideRelease: Let go to switch to the highlighted window

@guideStart.description: The guide's button, which hides it.

@guideTitle.description: The title of the guide shown over the switcher after the first launch.

@hintClear.description: The key hint of Escape while searching.

@hintMove.description: The key hint of the arrow keys.

@hintSwitch.description: The key hint of Return while searching.

@keySpace.description: The space bar, on a key cap.

layoutListDetail: Icons and titles alone, the most recent first: compact and quick.
layoutTabsDetail: Windows as tabs grouped by app, with a large preview to be sure.

@licenseActive.description: A license activated on this Mac.

licenseDeactivateDetail: Frees one of the license's three Macs.
licenseDeactivated: This Mac is deactivated: the key can serve another one.
licenseInvalid: This key is not valid, or it is active on three Macs already.
licenseNetwork: Could not reach the license server. Check the connection and try again.
licensePitch: The predicted next window, search ranked by your habits, and more to come. One purchase, three Macs.
licenseThanks: Thank you! Windeck Pro is activated.
licenseTrial: Trial · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
onboardShortcutDetail: Hold it and press Tab to go through your windows; let go to switch.
onboardShortcutNote: You can change it any time in Settings.
onboardWelcomeDetail: Switch to any window like a browser tab. Windeck needs two permissions; nothing ever leaves your Mac.
permAccessibilityDetail: Lists, raises, closes and minimizes windows.
permAccessibilityWhy: Needed to list your windows, switch to them, and hear the shortcut.
permScreenDetail: Shows windows' pictures in the preview.
permScreenRestart: macOS applies Screen Recording once Windeck restarts.
permScreenWhy: Shows large previews of your windows. Without it, Windeck shows titles only.
permStaleNote: Allowed already, and still asked? An update can leave the old Windeck switched on. Choose Allow…: Windeck clears the old entry, then turn Windeck on again.

@permStaleNote.description: Under the permission cards in onboarding, while Accessibility is not allowed.

previewApp: Running, with no windows open. Switching brings it forward.
previewExcluded: On your privacy list: Windeck never captures this app.
previewHidden: This app is hidden. Switching shows it again.
previewMinimized: Minimized before Windeck saw it, so there is no picture yet. Switching brings it back.
previewNoPermission: Allow Screen Recording in Settings to see previews.
previewOff: Previews are turned off in Settings.
privacyEmpty: No apps. Windeck captures every window.
privacyExcludedDetail: Windeck never captures these apps' windows, never keeps their titles, and learns nothing from them.

@privacyNotInstalled.description: A privacy list app that is not on this Mac.

privacyNotInstalledMore: {n, plural, one {# more app, not installed on this Mac} other {# more apps, not installed on this Mac}}

@privacyNotInstalledMore.description: The privacy list: the folded row of apps not installed.

privacyPromise: Window pictures, your habits and what Windeck learns stay on this Mac. Titles, pictures and app lists are never sent anywhere.
resetDetail: Forgets your habits, predictions and every window picture kept.

@rowRestore.description: The button of a minimized window's row that brings it back from the Dock.

@searchNoResults.description: The list, when the search finds nothing.

searchNoResultsHint: Try fewer letters, or part of the app’s name.
settingsPreviewsDetail: Off, the switcher shows titles alone.
settingsPrimaryDisplayDetail: Otherwise the panel shows where you work.
settingsQuickDelayDetail: Released sooner, the shortcut switches without showing the panel.

@settingsUpdates.description: A section of the About page.

settingsWindowlessDetail: Listed at the end, to bring them forward.
shortcutCommandDetail: Takes over ⌘Tab: for heavy multi-window use and Windows habits.
shortcutOptionDetail: Keeps the system's ⌘Tab for apps; ⌥Tab goes to windows.

@shortcutsActionKeys.description: A setting: W, M and Q act on the highlighted window.

shortcutsActionKeysDetail: Off, W, M and Q do nothing in the switcher.

@shortcutsActions.description: A heading of the Shortcuts page.

@shortcutsInSwitcher.description: A heading of the Shortcuts page: the keys while the switcher shows.

@shortcutsJump.description: What the left and right arrows do.

shortcutsMinimize: Minimize the window, or restore it
shortcutsMove: Move up and down the list

@shortcutsMove.description: What the up and down arrows do.

@shortcutsNext.description: What Tab does in the switcher.

@shortcutsOpen.description: A heading of the Shortcuts page.

@shortcutsOr.description: Between two keys that do the same.

@shortcutsPrevious.description: What Shift-Tab does in the switcher.

@shortcutsRelease.description: A key hint: releasing the shortcut's modifier.

shortcutsSearchNote: While searching, ↑ ↓ move, Return switches and Esc clears the query.

@shortcutsSwitch.description: What releasing the modifier, or Return, does.

smartLocalNote: Learned on this Mac only, from the windows you switch to.
smartNeedsPro: Smart features are part of Windeck Pro. Activate a license to turn them on.
smartPersonalDetail: The same letters bring the window you go to most first.
smartPredictDetail: The first Tab always goes back; the second goes where you usually go next.
splashTagline: Ready. Switch windows like browser tabs.

@splashTagline.description: Under the name, in the animation of the first launch.

@trayPlayIntro.description: A menu bar item of development builds: plays the first launch's intro again.

@trayRestartUpdate.description: A menu bar item, once an update was installed in the background.

updatesAutoDetail: Once a day, in the background.
updatesDisabled: This copy can't update itself. Download new versions from the website.

@updatesDisabled.description: Development builds, or an app where it cannot write.

updatesFailedDetail: Check your connection and try again.
updatesInstallDetail: New versions start the next time Windeck opens.
updatesPermissionNote: After the update, macOS may ask you to allow Accessibility again.

@updatesPermissionNote.description: A note in the update window.

@updatesReady.description: The update window, once the update is installed.

@updatesRelaunch.description: A button relaunching the app into the update.
